templates.name: Welcome
templates.when: Sent right after someone creates a workspace
templates.subject: Your ConverFlow workspace is ready, {{first_name}}
templates.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

Your ConverFlow workspace for {{business}} is live. You're on the {{plan_name}} plan with {{trial_days}} days free.

Three things worth doing first:
1. Connect your Instagram account
2. Pick a reel and set your trigger keyword
3. Test it on the Flow Tester before going live

Reply to this email if you get stuck — a real person answers.

{{brand_name}}

templates.name: Instagram connected
templates.when: Sent when a workspace links its Instagram account
templates.subject: @{{ig_handle}} is connected

templates.name: Trial ending
templates.when: Sent 3 days before a trial expires
templates.subject: {{days_left}} days left on your ConverFlow trial

templates.name: Trial expired
templates.when: Sent the day a trial runs out
templates.subject: Your automations are paused

templates.name: Payment received
templates.subject: Payment received — invoice {{invoice_no}}
templates.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

We've received {{amount}} for the {{plan_name}} plan. Your next renewal is {{renews_on}}.

Invoice {{invoice_no}} is attached, GST included.

{{brand_name}}

templates.name: Workspace suspended
templates.when: Sent when an account is suspended
templates.subject: Your ConverFlow workspace is on hold
templates.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

We've put your workspace on hold. Your data is safe and nothing has been deleted.

Write to {{support_email}} and we'll sort it out.

{{brand_name}}
